page.overview:
Who is Noriaki Kakyoin?

Noriaki Kakyoin joins Jotaro's party in Stardust Crusaders, wielding the emerald-slinging Stand Hierophant Green against DIO's agents.

Also known as: Kakyoin, Kakyoin Noriaki.
